summary: Removing the set-status pr-open gate leaves push and PR creation gated by SKILL.md step 8 and checkpoint approver --next pr, but opens a new unapproved local path from pr-open to drop.

findings.summary: Removing the pr-open gate in cmd_set_status lets set-status pr-open with any --pr-url succeed on a run with no approved record, and drop then archives that run, so a run can be ended and archived without the user's Approve. No push or PR is reachable through this path.
findings.evidence: ENG-25, ENG-26. cmd_set_status (lines 1358-1359) has no checks.gate_violation(s, 'pr') call. cmd_drop (lines 574-575) requires only status == 'pr-open'. Probe at 03871d2 refuses set-status pr-open (rc 1); at HEAD rc 0, and drop rc 0. Push and gh pr create remain after checkpoint approver --next pr (SKILL.md line 149), which still refuses without an approval.
findings.fix: Either record in plan.md and the ADR that set-status pr-open is intentionally ungated and that the approver checkpoint is the sole publication gate, or restore the pr-open refusal with a test after declaring set-status as a seam with fresh Confirmed acceptance under ENG-4.
